qualifications: All clearances nominal at zero preload. Source translates sensor, backing, keeper, spacers, screws, yoke and pusher synchronously, preserving their internal contact/clearance relationships. Independent continuous-motion/service checks are owned by the main validation report.
2.15mm S355 backplate stiffness and printed yoke/frame strength, creep and fatigue are unqualified. 200lbf sensor capacity is not device load rating.
Loose front keeper must remain separated after tolerances and deflection. No shims or shortening spacers to tighten against housing.
M3 blind bore and usable full thread require manufacturing confirmation; keep bore outside M2 corridor.
Real complete flexible lead/connector is not represented by manufacturer stub. Routing, strain relief, slack and minimum bend radius remain physical integration requirements.
M3 retention ear ligaments1.25upper/1.45rear mm and printed slot2.3mm are not rated high-force stop features.
